title: cdrgam 0.2.0
text: Establishes first public development release current CDR-GAM implementation. Provides native, dense block, sparse fitting backends continuous-time deconvolutional generalized additive models. Supports Gaussian, generalized, Gaussian location-scale models stream-aware prediction, inference, diagnostics, effect estimation. Adds bounded-memory history construction, checkpointed optimization, resource-aware parallel execution.
